scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload --app-dir src
scripts.build:api: cd apps/api && uv run ruff check . --fix && uv run black . && uv run isort . && uv run mypy .
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared-logic && npm run build --workspace=packages/ui-components && npm run build --workspace=packages/api-client
scripts.test:packages: npm run test --workspace=packages/shared-logic && npm run test --workspace=packages/ui-components && npm run test --workspace=packages/api-client
